bibliographic.title: Verb Adverbly
bibliographic.author: Nick Gelling
bibliographic.description:
Read efficiently. Decide carefully. Farewell appropriately.

An experimental game written for Neo-Twiny Jam 2025.

Designed for fullscreen - hit the button in the bottom right corner.

There are at least three distinct endings, each with several variations. Total word count is around 370.
